definition: Measures how difficult it is to hire in a region and sector using vacancy intensity, labour slack, and candidate movement signals.
notes: Phase 1 now uses vacancy, unemployment, labour slack, and labour-flow proxies while sector-level skills inputs are still pending.

definition: Summarizes labour-market strength using employment, unemployment, and workforce participation pressure.
notes: Phase 1 uses employment, unemployment, and labour-flow continuity where available.

definition: Signals likely pay-equity or representation pressure using pay-gap and workforce-balance inputs.
notes: Phase 2 blends market pay-gap intensity with internal worker-category pay gap and representation skew when trusted internal data is present; falls back to market-only ERS otherwise.

definition: Signals how prepared a region or company is for green and digital workforce shifts.
notes: Uses Eurostat digital-employer share (isoc_ske_itspe) and green-sector employment share (env_ac_egss1/lfsi_emp_a), weighted with labour resilience and hiring pressure using PCA-informed weights validated in scripts/validate_transition_readiness_weights.py. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-11-transition-readiness-validation-results.md for the full analysis. Fallback weights used because PC1 explained variance was 49.2% (<50%) on the 2026-09-11 validation run: digital 0.1500, green 0.1500, labour_resilience 0.4500, hiring_pressure 0.2500. Face-validity correlation vs unemployment_rate was -0.2294 (negative; expected negative) after aligning green_demand_share units with the mart (FTE / (THS_PER * 1000) * 100).
